verdict.rationale: BVNK documents API-driven stablecoin sends and payouts with Hawk-authenticated requests, and a probe found an official agent-wallet CLI, which suggests some agent-oriented payment tooling. Nothing in the evidence shows scoped authority or human-configured spend limits for an agent; the payment rules endpoint automates fiat-to-crypto routing and does not cap what an agent can spend. Missing for 10: documented agent payment flows, human-configured spend controls or limits, scoped or delegated agent credentials, details of what the agent-wallet CLI actually does, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
